price.source: Trade-Ideas (carried forward from prior pass; down ~78% YTD, ~48% over the trailing month per the same source)

catalysts.headline: Announced an exclusive option to license Hebei Senlang Biotechnology's CD7-targeted lentiviral in-vivo CAR-T platform (led by a Phase 1 BCMA/GPRC5D dual-targeting candidate for multiple myeloma), paired with a ~$2.5M warrant-based private placement

Tempest and Hebei Senlang Biotechnology announce a development collaboration; first step is an investigator-initiated trial (IIT) in China of Tempest's CD7-targeted in vivo CAR-T candidate TPST-4003 in approx. 10 patients with myasthenia gravis or multiple sclerosis, with first dosing expected Q4 2026 and initial clinical data guided for H1 2027

Tempest Q2 2026 results disclose a Q2 2026 warrant inducement raising approx. $1.7M (one secondary source states $2M), on top of a March 2026 private placement of common stock and warrants that raised net proceeds of $1.7M
catalysts.impact: Small dilutive financings; cash position remained thin through Q3 2026 (approx. $779K by 2026-10-16 per Trade-Ideas)

conflicts: WATCH FOR REVERSE SPLIT (flagging, not guessing a ratio): Tempest received a Nasdaq bid-price deficiency notice in December 2024 after closing below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days; shareholders approved a reverse split at an unspecified ratio between 1-for-2 and 1-for-15. A mid-2026 snapshot shows a 52-week price range of $1.22 to $12.23 — a ~10x spread consistent with a reverse split having occurred within that window. Exact ratio/effective date NOT confirmed this pass.

Share counts across sources differ by roughly 10x (4.44M vs 14.8M vs 43.64M) depending on date — almost certainly reflects the above reverse split plus subsequent dilutive financings (March 2026 PIPE at $2.16/share; the Sept 2026 ~$2.5M warrant private placement already on file), rather than any single source being simply wrong. Not reconciled.
Cash figures conflict sharply: $779K (SEC 8-K, 2026-06-30) vs $14.28M (undated aggregator) — the latter almost certainly predates the reverse split/dilution and should not be treated as current.
Market cap: readings found span ~$15.5M to ~$48.75M across sources/dates, driven by both conflicting share counts and non-contemporaneous prices — not reconciled.
notes: Despite a thorough search, NO new dated news, press release, or 8-K was found for TPST between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-30. The most recent filing located was the Aug 13, 2026 8-K covering Q2 2026 results (cash position above). Given the severe cash position and apparent reverse split/heavy dilution history, recommend treating all TPST share-count-derived figures (market cap, P/E, EPS) as unestablished until a current 10-Q or dated quote is obtained. Relevant pipeline context (not a dated catalyst): TPST-2003 CAR-T program reported a 100% complete response rate among 15 CAR-T-naive evaluable patients across partner-run trials in the Q2 2026 update; TPST-4003 (Senlang) collaboration first patient enrollment/dosing in China expected Q4 2026.
